control_points.what: roundabout at the south end of the dual road (map right edge)

method: two road landmarks drawn on the Avena cluster map matched to the same built roads on Esri imagery (z17): the S-shaped roundabout and the roundabout at the south end of the dual road; similarity transform (scale, rotation, shift). Independent checks: map-up 322.9 deg vs the Valley brochure maps 322.5 deg; scale 1.050 m/pt vs Nima 1.003 / Elva 0.977; map north arrow up-right
accuracy: provisional: two control points (no redundancy); estimated within about 10-15 m (landmark centres +/-3 m, rotation +/-0.6 deg over 600 m)
